> 第699章 兵临城下（第1页）
在两位伯爵斗志激昂的时刻，城内也在积极备战。
尤其是暴雨停歇之后，情况更是如此。
雨停的间隙不仅是攻城方的窗口期，更是守城方的备战期。
因此，德林邦城内迎来了一次相对短促的临战整备时间。
那些布设在关键之处的雨具大多都没有撤去。
除非有七阶水系魔导师坐镇，或是对应的
不多时，这两人便来到这片山谷。杜子平在一旁悄悄打量了一个，这两人居然都是金丹期的修士，一个高高瘦瘦，修为是金丹五层，一个却矮矮胖胖，修为是金丹四层。
一旦身体失去平衡，那人就知道情况不妙，赶忙竭力欲起。但那锦衣卫却不可能给他这么个翻身的机会，一声断喝，抢步而上，手中刀已如奔雷般狠狠刺出，扑哧一声便自对方的前胸而入。
他还想着趁袁绍立足未稳，且不管是不是师出无名，发了兵再说。只是他刚刚整合三军，他的大本营幽州传来告急。
秦悦风腹诽。这家伙三言两语把他给说动了，然后这半个月却连影子也不见一个，也太不够意思了吧？
杜子平在台下暗忖，龙飞这手神通似乎与他的天罡地煞血兽变有几分相似，只是威力远为不及。他却不知，这手神通本来就是参详了天罡地煞血兽变而创出的，不过只学了天罡地煞血兽变的一些皮毛而已。
一步步的踏出，每踏出一步，脚下的熔岩，便自然的朝着两边散开，一如当初那男子踏步而出。
那火虎王锋道：“引不出来，逼出来就可以了。”说完，他反手一掌拍出，一团火焰飞到草丛当中。
“陛下！”进来的人并没有依言出去，反而走近几步后，朝他躬身施了一礼。
“这个自然是免不了的，诏狱之中的那些手段大人必然比下官还要清楚些！”杨震很是坦率地一点头，承认了下来。
但帐中却没有传来回应，虽然现在是大半夜的，里面的人应该正在沉睡，可自己都如此直接地来了，又说了话，怎么还没有半点回应呢？
强大的波动都在这里完成了最后的催动，这里的奥义也在变得更可怕了。
余秋心里估算，这些药材，就是在地球，也不会这么贵，这说明一个情况，这个世界的资源居然这么匮乏？
叶宁举起手中的八百里开外手枪，枪口正对着一脸错愕的至尊宝。
大宋的官职实在是太多了，若非是审官院或是流内铨的资深官吏，旁人都很难一一理清。
想想之前洛菲菲紧张的样子，说不定是感受到了她对自己的恶意。
“你算什么家伙？特雷诺，为什么让他混进来？”莫甘娜翻了下白眼。
他手里的钱绝对不干净，也够心狠手辣，只是这几年洗白了，才收敛许多。
昨天睡晚了，还出去溜达了一圈，结果差点要耽误更新了。索性后面渐渐找到了感觉。
“这是学院的入学测试吗？”歌特“虚弱”的说。他自己就是贩卖魔法物品的行家，自然知道这些东西是做什么的。
似乎没想到会在这里碰到宫语，他脸上浮现出不可思议，随后又笑出了声。
张云泽一开始运球，朱佑樳教练身后的，两个手持海绵垫，与空气狼牙棒的人就涌了上来，拿着垫子就朝着张云泽推来，这种垫子是用来训练身体对抗的，张云泽平时也见过，所以也没有说什么。

Not long after, the two people came to this valley. Du Ziping quietly looked at one of them from the side. They were both monks at the Golden Core stage. One was tall and thin, with a cultivation level of the fifth level of the Golden Core. The other was short and fat, with a cultivation level of the fourth level of the Golden Core.
Once the body loses balance, the person knows that something is wrong and tries his best to get up. But the Jin Yiwei couldn't give him such a chance to stand up. He shouted loudly and rushed forward. The knife in his hand had been stabbed out like thunder, and with a thud, it penetrated the opponent's chest.
He also wanted to take advantage of Yuan Shao's unsteady foothold and send troops first, regardless of whether his troops were out of nowhere. But he had just integrated the three armies, and there was an emergency in Youzhou, his base camp.
Qin Yuefeng slandered. This guy persuaded him with a few words, but then he didn't even see a shadow in the past half month. Isn't it too interesting?
Du Ziping secretly thought in the audience that Long Fei's magical power seemed to be somewhat similar to his Tiangang Earth Evil Blood Beast Transformation, but it was far less powerful. Little did he know that this magical power was originally created after studying the transformation of Tiangang's evil blood beast, but he only learned some superficial knowledge of the transformation of Tiangang's evil blood beast.
Step by step, every time he took a step, the lava under his feet naturally spread to both sides, just like when the man stepped out.
The Fire Tiger Wang Feng said: "If you can't lure it out, just force it out." After saying that, he slapped out a palm with his backhand, and a ball of flame flew into the grass.
"Your Majesty!" The person who came in did not go out as instructed. Instead, he took a few steps closer and bowed to him.
"This is naturally unavoidable. The masters must know the methods in the prison better than the subordinates!" Yang Zhen nodded frankly and admitted.
But there was no response from the tent. Although it was the middle of the night and the people inside were probably sleeping, he came so directly and spoke again, so why didn't he get any response?
The powerful fluctuations have completed their final impulse here, and the secrets here have become more terrifying.
Yu Qiu estimated in her mind that these medicinal materials would not be so expensive even on earth. Does this mean that the resources in this world are so scarce?

There were so many official positions in the Song Dynasty that it would be difficult for others to sort them out one by one unless they were senior officials from the Juguan Yuan or Liu Neiquan.
Thinking about Luo Feifei's nervous look before, maybe he felt her malice towards him.
"Who are you? Traynor, why did you let him sneak in?" Morgana rolled her eyes.
The money in his hands is definitely not clean, and he is very ruthless. It is only in the past few years that he has become more restrained.
I slept late last night and went out for a walk, which almost delayed the update. I finally found the feeling gradually.
"Is this the college's entrance test?" Gott said weakly. He himself is an expert in selling magic items, so he naturally knows what these items are used for.
As if he didn't expect to meet Gong Yu here, a look of disbelief appeared on his face, and then he laughed out loud.
